document: FWFS E04 Part 1 — Director decisions and evidence-only mapping
source_policy: Use unchanged DHIKA source lines as evidence. Separate written FWFS, review copies, Director decisions, and proposals. Never invent prior continuity. No manuscript text changed.

director_decisions.director_raw_input: Director decision for FWFS E04 Part 1 DHIKA E03 L005–010: Option A — new Friday skirt and sleeveless top, no invented previous Ritvik backstory.. Record this as my decision and continue with the next source set, without writing prose yet.
director_decisions.decision: Select new Friday skirt plus sleeveless top as a deliberate current wardrobe choice. Do NOT invent a previously proposed/refused Ritvik outfit or transport John/Aunty/Uncle anecdote to FWFS.
director_decisions.decision_status: DIRECTOR APPROVED FOR ADAPTATION PLANNING; NOT MANUSCRIPT CANON

blocking_decisions.question: At the time of Chotu's delivery, where are Rey and Ritvik? No FWFS source currently establishes Friday morning presence or absence.
FWFS Thursday's shopkeeper only says he took sudden leave; preserve as unexplained until Director decides, without importing DHIKA grandmother death.
Should original E03 L014 cheek-tap be retained as a first-time spontaneous greeting, or deliberately omitted? FWFS has no proven habitual cheek-tap.
